text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm-hmmm♪ Hm-hm-hm-hmmm~♪
choice_data_list: You seem to be in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer! Happy New Year~♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ To tell you the truth, I was at the 
year-end live afterparty until just now...
choice_data_list: And you're saying that made you dizzy?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm nooot drunk at aaall! Full of energy, 
seeee~! So let's head to karaoke♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help it! Watching the countdown 
concert made me want to sing my heart out 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: And with that, LET'S GO~~☆

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, want to do a duet?! The New 
Year's food menu looks super tempting too, 
don't you think?♪
choice_data_list: Maybe you should head back instead……

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Come now, come now! It's the joyous New 
Year, so let's just let loose! Right?
choice_data_list: Let's eat and take a breather!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ Then let's go with... that famous 
masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Uhh! Umapyoi! Umapyoi! Uhh! Suki-dacchi☆

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Huff... puff... ...J-Just one song... and 
I'm... this exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
........Um, Trainer. Thank you for joining 
me, or rather, well...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
........I-I am terribly sorry... for 
causing trouble!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had been worried about how things would 
turn out, but seeing that she'd sobered up 
brought a wave of relief.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go with this gorgeous New 
Year's feast! Spiny lobster, crab, and 
roast beef for five♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
*phew*... That was so delicious... I'm so 
full, I...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Somehow... my eyelids... feel so heavy...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Trainer... Thank you for walking 
me...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yaaawn...... Ehehe... I feel like I'm 
going to have a wonderful first dream of 
the year...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Light Hello called to 
apologize, embarrassedly saying, "I'm so 
sorry for causing you trouble!"
